rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when stressing that something is present everywhere in a particular place or area.

example.english: The pervasiveness of shared bikes in this area is really something.
example.traditional: 呢區共享單車無處不在嘅情況，真係幾誇張。
example.jyutping: ne1 keoi1 gung6 hoeng2 daan1 ce1 mou4 cyu3 bat1 zoi6 ge3 cing4 fong3 zan1 hai6 gei2 kwaa1 zoeng1

rows.note: Use this more formal noun when discussing how widespread or generally present something is, without insisting on literal presence in every part.

example.english: This report analyzes the pervasiveness of online scams.
example.traditional: 呢份報告分析咗網絡詐騙嘅普遍性。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 fan1 sik1 zo2 mong5 lok6 zaa3 pin3 ge3 pou2 pin3 sing3
